commands.command:
set -eu
sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/srvdata-snapshot >/dev/null <<'SNAPSHOT_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

BASE=/var/lib/srvdata-snapshots
ORIGIN_IMG=$BASE/origin.img
COW_IMG=$BASE/snapshot.cow
ACTIVE=$BASE/active
ORIGIN_DM=srvdata-origin
SNAP_DM=srvdata-snapshot
MERGE_DM=srvdata-merge
DATA_MNT=/srv/data
SNAP_MNT=$BASE/view
CHUNK_SECTORS=8
ORIGIN_SIZE=2G
COW_SIZE=2G

need_root() {
    if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "must run as root" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

loop_for() {
    /sbin/losetup -j "$1" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p'
}

attach_loop() {
    file=$1
    dev=$(loop_for "$file")
    if [ -z "$dev" ]; then
        dev=$(/sbin/losetup --find --show "$file")
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$dev"
}

dm_exists() {
    /sbin/dmsetup info "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

is_mounted() {
    /bin/mountpoint -q "$1"
}

setup_data() {
    /sbin/modprobe dm_snapshot
    mkdir -p "$BASE" "$DATA_MNT" "$SNAP_MNT"
    if [ ! -f "$ORIGIN_IMG" ]; then
        echo "origin image is missing; run: $0 init" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    origin=$(attach_loop "$ORIGIN_IMG")
    sectors=$(/sbin/blockdev --getsz "$origin")
    if ! dm_exists "$ORIGIN_DM"; then
        if [ -f "$ACTIVE" ]; then
            if [ ! -f "$COW_IMG" ]; then
                echo "active snapshot marker exists but COW image is missing" >&2
                exit 1
            fi
            cow=$(attach_loop "$COW_IMG")
            if ! dm_exists "$SNAP_DM"; then
                /sbin/dmsetup create "$SNAP_DM" --table "0 $sectors snapshot $origin $cow P $CHUNK_SECTORS"
            fi
            /sbin/dmsetup create "$ORIGIN_DM" --table "0 $sectors snapshot-origin $origin"
        else
            /sbin/dmsetup create "$ORIGIN_DM" --table "0 $sectors linear $origin 0"
        fi
    fi
    if ! is_mounted "$DATA_MNT"; then
        mount /dev/mapper/$ORIGIN_DM "$DATA_MNT"
    fi
}

init_data() {
    /sbin/modprobe dm_snapshot
    mkdir -p "$BASE" "$DATA_MNT" "$SNAP_MNT"
    if [ -e "$ORIGIN_IMG" ]; then
        echo "origin image already exists" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    /usr/bin/fallocate -l "$ORIGIN_SIZE" "$ORIGIN_IMG"
    chmod 600 "$ORIGIN_IMG"
    origin=$(attach_loop "$ORIGIN_IMG")
    sectors=$(/sbin/blockdev --getsz "$origin")
    /sbin/dmsetup create "$ORIGIN_DM" --table "0 $sectors linear $origin 0"
    /sbin/mkfs.xfs -f -L srvdata /dev/mapper/$ORIGIN_DM >/dev/null
    mount /dev/mapper/$ORIGIN_DM "$DATA_MNT"
    echo "initialized $DATA_MNT on /dev/mapper/$ORIGIN_DM"
}

create_snapshot() {
    setup_data
    if [ -f "$ACTIVE" ] || dm_exists "$SNAP_DM"; then
        echo "a snapshot is already active" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    /usr/bin/fallocate -l "$COW_SIZE" "$COW_IMG"
    chmod 600 "$COW_IMG"
    cow=$(attach_loop "$COW_IMG")
    origin=$(loop_for "$ORIGIN_IMG")
    sectors=$(/sbin/blockdev --getsz "$origin")
    sync
    /sbin/xfs_freeze -f "$DATA_MNT"
    /sbin/dmsetup suspend "$ORIGIN_DM"
    /sbin/dmsetup create "$SNAP_DM" --table "0 $sectors snapshot $origin $cow P $CHUNK_SECTORS"
    /sbin/dmsetup reload "$ORIGIN_DM" --table "0 $sectors snapshot-origin $origin"
    /sbin/dmsetup resume "$ORIGIN_DM"
    /sbin/xfs_freeze -u "$DATA_MNT"
    date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$ACTIVE"
    mount -o ro,nouuid /dev/mapper/$SNAP_DM "$SNAP_MNT"
    echo "snapshot created at $(cat "$ACTIVE") and mounted read-only at $SNAP_MNT"
}

restore_snapshot() {
    setup_data
    if [ ! -f "$ACTIVE" ] || ! dm_exists "$SNAP_DM"; then
        echo "no active snapshot to restore" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    origin=$(loop_for "$ORIGIN_IMG")
    cow=$(loop_for "$COW_IMG")
    sectors=$(/sbin/blockdev --getsz "$origin")
    sync
    if is_mounted "$SNAP_MNT"; then
        umount "$SNAP_MNT"
    fi
    umount "$DATA_MNT"
    /sbin/dmsetup remove "$ORIGIN_DM"
    /sbin/dmsetup remove "$SNAP_DM"
    /sbin/dmsetup create "$MERGE_DM" --table "0 $sectors snapshot-merge $origin $cow P $CHUNK_SECTORS"
    complete=no
    i=0
    while [ "$i" -lt 120 ]; do
        status=$(/sbin/dmsetup status "$MERGE_DM")
        allocated=$(printf '%s\n' "$status" | awk '{split($4,a,"/"); print a[1]}')
        metadata=$(printf '%s\n' "$status" | awk '{print $5}')
        if [ "$allocated" -le "$metadata" ]; then
            complete=yes
            break
        fi
        sleep 1
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    if [ "$complete" != yes ]; then
        echo "snapshot merge did not complete: $status" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    /sbin/dmsetup remove "$MERGE_DM"
    /sbin/dmsetup create "$ORIGIN_DM" --table "0 $sectors linear $origin 0"
    /sbin/xfs_repair -n /dev/mapper/$ORIGIN_DM >/dev/null
    mount /dev/mapper/$ORIGIN_DM "$DATA_MNT"
    /sbin/losetup -d "$cow"
    rm -f "$COW_IMG" "$ACTIVE"
    echo "snapshot restored by block merge; $DATA_MNT is mounted"
}

show_status() {
    setup_data
    echo "data_mount=$(findmnt -n -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,TARGET "$DATA_MNT")"
    echo "active_snapshot=$([ -f "$ACTIVE" ] && cat "$ACTIVE" || echo none)"
    /sbin/dmsetup status "$ORIGIN_DM"
    if dm_exists "$SNAP_DM"; then
        /sbin/dmsetup status "$SNAP_DM"
    fi
}

need_root
case "${1:-}" in
    init) init_data ;;
    setup) setup_data ;;
    create) create_snapshot ;;
    restore) restore_snapshot ;;
    status) show_status ;;
    *) echo "usage: $0 {init|setup|create|restore|status}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
SNAPSHOT_SCRIPT
